plain_description.what: The first single construction loop over all six corpora together (21,606 questions, 18 models, 52 declared anchors). It counts leaves, filing accuracy and certified branch points per source against the single-corpus builds. No judge calls; descriptive.
plain_description.why: It checks whether one tree can be built over a multi-corpus union without losing quality.
plain_description.information: If certification holds up, one union loop is enough. If it collapses, the construction must change. Result: done. 147 leaves, filing accuracy 0.785. Only 5 of 94 branch points certified, against 8-11 on MMLU-Pro alone: one loop spreads the budget too thin per anchor. This led to the federated design (one tree per corpus, joined under a common root).
